notes.content:

[i]("cagatayerol" screenshot from community hub)[/i]

[h1][b]Hello DvDrummers![/b][/h1]

It's been a while since the last update, and there have been [b]several improvements[/b] to make [b]DvDrum [/b]even better. The overall [b]performance [/b]of the simulator has been [b]improved[/b], which should [b]improve [/b]the overall [b]drumming experience[/b]. 
The other changes includes [b]improvements [/b]to the [b]inputs management[/b], especially [b]MIDI controllers[/b], with improved performance and support for more devices.
The [b]Workshop[/b] has been improved too with [b]various bugs fixed[/b] and [b]improvements [/b]to the [b]items management[/b] with a simplified process.

[b].. and much more![/b]


[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1756935765108148013/4F0DFA014F499162D27CE94938E030A972E79524/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
[i]("pewangskoo's house" screenshot from community hub)[/i]


[h2][b]CHANGELOG[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Full ported to[b] 64 bit[/b]. 
[*] Improved [b]performance [/b]and [b]reactivity[/b].
[*] Updated [b]MIDI support[/b], with improved performance and increased [b]devices compatibility[/b] (this requires to remap MIDI devices due to refactor internal indexes).
[*] [b]Improved Workshop[/b] usability.
[*] [b]Editing [/b]a Workshop [b]item [/b]now [b]auto-compile[/b] the [b]files [/b]fields which makes it easier update the items.
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]the [b]Drumless Tracks items[/b] type in Workshop.
[*] [b]Fixed private state[/b] of Workshop item that auto become public. It will be set public only if included in a public drumkit now.
[*] [b]Fixed [/b]a mismatch of some [b]Workshop items indexes[/b] that caused drumkits to load [b]wrong components images[/b] and [b]sounds[/b].
[*] [b]Improved Workshop files checking[/b] to include new items immediately. 
[*] [b]Removed [/b]the [b]requirement [/b]of [b]mono-channel[/b] for Workshop [b]sounds [/b]type. [b]Stereo works[/b] well now.
[*] [b]Removed [/b]annoying [b]private items[/b] message [b]pop-up[/b].
[*] [b]Fixed Workshop[/b] random [b]crashes[/b].
[*] [b]Added tips[/b] during [b]Workshop [/b]file [b]checking[/b]
[*] [b]Improved [/b]precision for Workshop [b]Items Scores[/b].
[*] Some [b]improvements [/b]to [b]Workshop tags[/b].
[*] [b]Improved [/b]and Fixed [b]Texts Items[/b] behaviour.
[*] [b]Improved components renaming[/b] by increased chars count and leggibility.
[*] [b]Improved descriptions[/b] and [b]tips[/b].
[*] [b]Increased fonts quality.[/b]
[*] Some [b]tweaks [/b]to [b]sound quality[/b].
[*] [b]Improved [/b]images [b]resizing[/b].
[*] Small [b]improvements [/b]to [b]shadows[/b].
[*] [b]Improved [/b]some [b]effects[/b].
[*] [b]Improved screenshots [/b]management.
[*] [b]Other improvements[/b]..

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/58112da91d80a133a6f321776e4cf0cd532f7830.png[/img]


[b]Hello DvDrummers! 
It's time to Beta! DvDrum is now stable and needs only some small improvements and tweaks 
before final release, that is expected at the end of January 2017!
We are working hard to make the best Drummer experience with DvDrum.

A lot of new features and improvements are been made since first Early Access version as:
MIDI Support, Infinite Customization System, Workshop Support, Cloud Support, a lot of new Sounds and Images, New Sound Control and Much More!

This is the last Early Access update probably, the next will be the Release!
We are working on some new things to add and improve before release and will be working hard to make the release version better as possible.

We invite you to report all things (also tiny) and your experience with DvDrum in Steam Discussion or by compiling this fast Survey:  
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeZY23yx7kl7Tl5nFOwzxnrZVMv1ReJjykIdmvZl7nMWydH2Q/viewform

Some your nice videos and screenshots will be published in next Trailer! ;)


[h1][b]Changelog:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 30+ New Sounds!
[*] Improved Joystick Performance
[*] Added In-Game Item Name Preview before Workshop Publishing
[*] Added a Different Coloration for Workshop Images and Sounds
[*] Improved Workshop Error Messages
[*] Updated and Improved Help Guide 
[*] Removed Christmas Event

notes.title: Update 3.6.0 Is Live! The Sandbox Drum Simulator!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/7bb3b9df73d08dba8bf11ba32a1511319dd4608a.png[/img]

[b]Hello DvDrummers!

It’s been a while since the last update, but the Big Update is Here!

In all this time We have worked hard to rewrite and improve a lot of DvDrum features, and We are very happy to release the new version!
The new DvDrum philosophy is oriented to the best drum simulation and maximum creative freedom.

[h1]
This is a big update with a lot of changes, please give us your feedback about problems or bugs found during the play, Thanks!

This new update introduce a new drumkit file format: “.dvx”
The previous Drumkit, SoundSet and KeysMap files will be removed automatically, because are no longer compatible with new system.
[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/05270a93eb709cf038ff01fb59ebe013e2521b42.png[/img]


[h1][b]SEMPLIFIED DRUMKITS MANAGEMENT![/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Auto-Assign Drumkit on Slot
[*] The Slots Are Organized to 4 per Page Now
[*] Removed the Limit of 4 Drumkit on Main Menu
[*] Removed Slot Settings Section
[*] Remove Drumkit by Pressing Mouse Right Button on Drumkit Slot
[*] Fast Drumkit Creation by Pressing on a Empty Slot
[*] Is Possible Duplicate the Drumkit by Presusefullsing Save Icon in Drumkit Section
[*] Suspended the Drumkit Name Colour
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/aaf7984f78c18220787ffddce250cba9b4b2ee32.png[/img]


[h1][b]NEW COMPONENTS MANAGEMENT![/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Completelly Reworked the Components Management
[*] Every Components Have a Customizable Name now!
[*] Added New Window to Add the Components
[*] Added Automatic Component Name Numeration
[*] Removed the Components Number Limit!
[*] Added a Short Description for Every Component
[*] Added Button for Remove Components
[*] Added Button for Rename Components
[*] Added Key for Fast Component Modification (F5), Very Useful!
[*] F5 to Change Image\Position\Scale\Angle\Layer on a Component!
[*] Stands are Independent Components Now!
[*] Carpets are Indpendent Components Now!
[*] Added Type Indication on Component When Mouse is Enter
[*] The “Low Gain Snare/Shading Snare” Needs to Be Linked on a Snare Now
[*] Removed the Load Icon, It is Useless Now with Automatic Loading
[*] The Save Icon Can Duplicate the Drumkit or Save the Current
[*] Revamped Drumkit Interface
[*] Removed SoundSet and KeysMap settings, All in One now!
[*] Added HotKeys to Main Drumkit Sections
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/bed06a05e9142f59ad84af34e5f0cbb5df409741.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/5badf932d41d31873786c61f6c613f48ada25bea.png[/img]


[h1][b]NEW COMPONENTS TYPES![/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added New Component Type: “Octoban”
[*] Added New Component Type: “Max Stax”
[*] Added New Component Type: “Bell”
[*] Added New Component Type: “Custom”
[*] The Custom Type is Useful to Add a New Type with Custom Images and Sounds
[/list]
[h1]P.S. This New Types Need More Work.[/h1]


[h1][b]SUPPORT FOR CUSTOM IMAGES AND SOUNDS![/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The Custom Images and Sounds will be Loaded In DvDrum at Start
[*] Add Your Image in “Appdata\Local\DvDrum\Workshop\Images\”
[*] The Images Needs “.PNG” Format
[*] Add your Sound in “Appdata\Local\DvDrum\Workshop\Sounds\”
[*] The Sounds Needs “.OGG” and Mono (1 channel) Format
[/list]
[h1]P.S. This Is the First Step for Workshop Support, Please Test It Very Well![/h1]


[h1][b]REVAMPED INPUTS MANAGEMENT![/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased to 4 Keys Settable for Every Components
[*] Added Action Hold Keys to Change the Sound Mode
[*] Increased to 2 Keys Settable for Every “Low Gain Snare/Shading Snare”
[*] Removed the KeysMap File Management. All in One now! 
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/c1c6fe3dbdf1a219b41eef45fa0df895746f7ea7.png[/img]


[h1][b]REVAMPED SOUND MANAGEMENT![/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 2 Sound Mode: “Standard” and “Action Hold”
[*] Sound Mode is Switchable by Pressing “Action Hold” Keys
[*] Hi-Hat Open/Close is Switchable by Pressing “Hi-Hat Pedal” Keys
[*] Removed the SoundSet File Management. All in One now!
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/6382e262ee80ac28b40e9c0462f55c624fc47409.png[/img]


[h1][b]OTHER CHANGES:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased FPS Cap from 144 to 240 (This Could Improve Reactivity)
[*] Improved Reactivity by Some Code Optimization
[*] Suspended Legacy/Compatibily Mode for Maximum Performance
[*] Fixed an Audio Bug when a Sound is Double Assigned on Different Components
[*] Improved RAM Management
[*] Reduced DvDrum Size on Disk
[*] Various Bugs Fixed
[/list]

[h1][b]NEXT STEPS:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] New Features to Facilitate and Improve Drumkit Building
[*] More Realistic Sound Simulation, Every Hit Sound Slightly Different
[*] New Components Sounds
[/list]


[h1]This is a big update with a lot of changes, please give us your feedback about problems or bugs found during the play, Thanks![/h1]

[/b]

[h1][b]Have Rockin' Fun!
\m/ __ (- . -) __ \m/[/b][/h1]

notes.title: NEXT UPDATE PREVIEW: Revamped Mixer and New Action Hold Feature!
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/294cec0125cfecdb6521a8afd6c06df24176d54d.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/e2184f04ae11a4e97c6227cf575dc6d984fe2078.png[/img][/url]


[h1][b]Hello DvDrummers![/b][/h1]

[b]From the last development update We have worked to revamp the mixer and the sound management of DvDrum, to adapt it to the new infinite drumkit system!
The new mixer is like to old, but it includes a new and important feature: "Action Hold"!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/294cec0125cfecdb6521a8afd6c06df24176d54d.png[/img]

[h1][b]THE NEW FEATURE: ACTION HOLD![/b][/h1]
This new feature allows to change dynamically the components sounds during the playback. It works like the Hi-Hat Pedal, by pressing the "Action Hold" Key. 

Every component have two sound settings now, and the new feature allows to set the  secondary component sound setting, to switch after from "STANDARD MODE" to "ACTION HOLD MODE" by pressing the action key during the playback. 
The Hi-Hat component uses the Hi-Hat Pedal key to switch mode, from "OPEN" to "CLOSE".

The mixer will change visually by changing the current sound mode:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/6382e262ee80ac28b40e9c0462f55c624fc47409.png[/img]

With the new "Action Hold" feature will increase the possibility to make new sound effect during the drum playback, for make a better and realistic drummer experience!


[h1][b]UPDATED DEVELOPMENT STATUS:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/385130/discussions/0/360670708786674071/[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]What are you think? ;-)


Have Rockin' Fun!
\m/ __ (- . -) __ \m/
[/b][/h1]
[/b]

[b]Hello guys!
The next update of DvDrum will be a Big Update,
We are rewriting a lot of DvDrum features to make the best drum simulator ever!
Unfortunatelly the next update require a bit of time to be released, we are working at full power, but there is much work to do!
After this update, DvDrum will be better and more reactive!

Simultaneously We are working on new DvDrum website, darktigerdevelop.com is down now. 

We are currently completing the new Drumkit Components Management,
here a pic of new components adding window:[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9752019/bbed0e9131c2694d23fdb98b4462eb5e82ed50e7.png[/img]

[h1][b]EXTREME DRUMKIT SUPPORT![/b][/h1][b]The new components system remove the limit of drumkit components number, is possible to create extreme drumkits now!
We have added type description, customizable components name and type quantity.[/b]

[h1][b]NEW COMPONENTS TYPE AND CUSTOM TYPE![/b][/h1][b]We have introduced new components type as "Max Stax", "Bell", "Octoban" and "Custom". The custom type allows you to create your personal componet type!

[h1][b]CUSTOM IMAGES SUPPORT![/b][/h1][b]DvDrum now support the customs components images, you can create your personal images!
This is the first implementation for future Workshop support.

[h1][b]THE NEXT STEPS[/b][/h1][b]The next step is to rewrite the save/load system to support the infinite drumkits combinations, this breaks the current compatibility with custom save and load files.
After this We will working on mixer improvements and custom sounds support!

[h1][b]Let us know what you think, it is very important to us, Thanks![/b][/h1]
Stay Tuned!

[/b]
[h1][b]
Have Rockin' Fun!
\m/__ (- . -) __\m/
[/b][/h1]

notes.title: DvDrum, Ultimate Drum Simulator v3.1.0 Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://darktigerdevelop.altervista.org/IMMAGINI/LogoBAnner616_Steam_Store_Page_.png[/img]

[b][h1]We are pleased to announce the release DvDrum 3.1.0 on Steam![/h1]

This is an important step that will lead to boost  the development and improvement of DvDrum.
We eliminated any annoying ads of freeware software by introducing a small initial price, making the development and the installation more clean, practical and faster.
Every new release and update of DvDrum will be installed automatically from Steam for maximum convenience!

Steam offers plenty of services such as Workshop, which will be exploited in the next versions of DvDrum order to add new interesting functionality.

DvDrum is an Early Access game,
all features and existing modes will be expanded and improved with future updates. New features are planned in the coming updates.
Every bugs segnalation and ideas of improvement are be welcome.

It is highly recommended for those who wish DvDrum of buy it in Early Access, to take advantage of the low price.


[u]Main Changes than DvDrum 3.0.6:[/u]
[list]
[*] New Sound Manager, Mixer!
[*] New Sound Engine
[*] Added Joystick and External Device Support as RockBand® and GuitarHero® Drumkit!, up to 32 Differents Inputs!
[*] New Customizations Extensions, dkx, ssx, kmx (not compatible with old versions)
[*] New Keys Customizable
[*] New Easy Keys Change Mode
[*] Improved Customization Icons
[*] Various Bugs Fixed and Improvements
[/list]
[/b]
